title: Leaderboard flags and rosters; changelog tab
changes: Leaderboard columns are now #, Country, Team, Roster and Elo.
Leaderboard rows now show each team's country flag and current roster under the team name, so the mobile view uses its full width.
Model and UI changelogs moved to their own tab under About, with a link to the GitHub repository.

title: Night Match redesign
changes: New dark navy and boost-orange visual system with Barlow typography and skewed boost-segment meters.
Elo leaderboard moved to its own page.
Player picker and weight sliders are now tabs in the sidebar, and the picker has a Clear all button.
Lineups with no shared match history hide the Synergy meter instead of showing a misleading +0.000.

title: Archetype cluster chart
changes: K-Means cluster scatter plot added to the About page.
